statement: WebQSP (and CWQ, which is generated from it) is built on Freebase, a structured knowledge base, so these standard multi-hop KGQA benchmarks do not carry source passages from which co-passage context triples could be drawn.

evidence.quote: WebQuestionsSP (webqsp)[36] contains 4737 natural language questions that are answerable using Freebase as the knowledge base. The questions require up to 2-hop reasoning from knowledge base.
